##### Summary
Fixes #7160 

Coverity reported us that the callocz was allocating to a pointer to pointer a simple vector, this was using more memory than necessary and thanks this we did not have any bug reported, this PR fixes this problem
##### Component Name
Collectors

review_comments:
I prefer:
`st_nodezonetype = callocz(pagelines_cnt, sizeof(*st_nodezonetype));`
cause this way you don't have to go lookup the definition. Also, if the definition changes you don't have to remember changing the allocation as well.
I understand your point, but case the variable type is changed, a lot of other things will be changed in this code.
